subject: [hw] J02 -> IP: the 5 libSystem symbols the iOS link needs (proved with a dry-run link)
body:
I dry-ran both links for iOS 16 arm64 with gpu/video/sdk/lib/*.tbd + ld64.lld, so this is not a guess:
[V] Plug-in link: my jpeg/rwjpeg.c + jpeg/n2jpeg_hw_vt.c + vt/n2vt_log.c link as a Mach-O arm64 dylib (install_name Slim.videoencoder) with every symbol covered except ONE: _ioctl. All CF/CM/CV/VT names are already in your TBDs.
[V] Tool executable link: same rwjpeg.c + rwjpeg_tool.c links as a Mach-O arm64 executable with everything covered except _ioctl, _printf, _sscanf, _strerror, ___stdoutp.
Proposed exact lines for gpu/video/sdk/symbols.txt (all are libSystem exports; the owners are the obvious libsystem_kernel/libsystem_c ones, make_tbds folds them):
  /usr/lib/system/libsystem_kernel.dylib   _ioctl
  /usr/lib/system/libsystem_c.dylib        _printf
  /usr/lib/system/libsystem_c.dylib        _sscanf
  /usr/lib/system/libsystem_c.dylib        _strerror
  /usr/lib/system/libsystem_c.dylib        ___stdoutp
(If you prefer not to grow sdk/symbols.txt, a gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/symbols.txt + a second glob in make_tbds.py would also work, but make_tbds is in gpu/video and yours.)
For reference, my dry-run commands (objects in /tmp):
  clang -c --target=arm64-apple-ios16.0 ... gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/rwjpeg.c -o rwjpeg.o
  ld64.lld -arch arm64 -platform_version ios 16.0 17.0 -dylib -install_name /System/Library/VideoEncoders/Slim.videoencoder -adhoc_codesign -o j02plugin.dylib rwjpeg.o n2jpeg_hw_vt.o n2vt_log.o sdk/lib/*.tbd extra.tbd
  -> Mach-O 64-bit arm64 dynamically linked shared library, NOUNDEFS
  ld64.lld -arch arm64 -platform_version ios 16.0 17.0 -adhoc_codesign -o rwjpeg_tool.ios rwjpeg_tool.o rwjpeg.o sdk/lib/*.tbd extra.tbd
  -> Mach-O 64-bit arm64 executable, NOUNDEFS
Once the symbols are in the TBDs I can run the real link through your script and post the result. Do you want the tools executable link in your build script, or should the main session build/install it separately? The tool takes no frameworks beyond libSystem.
